verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents identity stitching: once a user is identified, it automatically amends earlier records tied to the anonymous cookie-based ID. Profile Builder creates warehouse customer profiles from identify traits, and custom JavaScript logic can run over up to a year of event history, which makes the rules configurable. However, cross-device merging is never stated explicitly, and there are no documented resolution or merge rules beyond writing your own function. Missing for 10: explicit cross-device stitching, documented and configurable identity-resolution and merge rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
